summary.text: Donni Steele is a Republican state representative from Michigan House of Representatives District 54 and the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 23 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former real estate broker and Orion Township treasurer, she is not seeking re-election to the House.

paragraphs.text: Donni Steele was born in Oakland County, Michigan, lives in Orion Township, and graduated from Lake Orion High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree in business management from Western Michigan University in 1987.
Her career experience includes owning Coldwell Banker Shooltz Realty and working as a realtor, property manager and associate broker.
Steele served as a trustee and as treasurer of Orion Township.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she was elected Orion Township trustee in 2012 and treasurer in 2016, serving two terms, before her election to the state House.

She said she chairs the Appropriations Subcommittee on State and Local Transportation and is vice chair of the Appropriations Subcommittee on Licensing and Regulatory Affairs and Insurance and Financial Services.
In the same survey, Steele named fiscal responsibility, transparency and accountability within state government, and school excellence, among her key messages.
